pages.text: $(bold)Tier 2 reached.$() The mid-tier frontiers open to you.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Dimensions:$() the Twilight Forest, The Aether, Blue Skies.$(li)$(bold)Tech:$() the Thermal Series, basic Industrial Foregoing.$(li)$(bold)Magic:$() Ars Nouveau.$(li)$(bold)Gear:$() Steel, Manasteel, Steeleaf, Fiery - and the first Simply Swords uniques, from Twilight bosses.

pages.title: What's Next
pages.text: Toward $(t3)Tier 3$(): bank $(t3)1000$() tokens, or clear $(t3)90%$() of the Tier 2 bosses.$(br2)Track it with $(l:icraft:progression/check_your_standing)Check Your Standing$(/l). $(note)Diamonds are still a Tier 3 material - not yet in worldgen or chests.$()
